summary: Spring Boot auto-discovery incorrectly requires workflow packages configuration to register Activity beans, when activities should be auto-registered independently. The configuration name `packages` is also misleading since it only filters workflows, not activities.
userImpact: Users cannot auto-register Activity beans without also specifying workflow package filters, breaking activity auto-discovery when no workflow packages are configured.
rootCause: Activity auto-discovery registration is gated on `spring.temporal.workers-auto-discovery.packages` being non-empty, but this configuration is intended only for workflow package filtering.
proposedFix: Either (1) always register @ActivityImpl beans with matching workers regardless of packages configuration, or (2) introduce a separate flag like `spring.temporal.workers-auto-discovery.register-activities` to control activity bean auto-registration.
keyQuote: activities are not component scanned for registration to a worker _unless_ `spring.temporal.workers-auto-discovery.packages` is non-empty.
